source.label: cie-a-level-biology-25
source.method: yt-dlp flat channel enumeration + oEmbed identity sweep + LLM title-to-spec adjudication; evidence is TITLE-ONLY; AQA<->CIE divergence handled by conservative binding (medium/low only, no high rows). NOTE: freesciencelessons videos with embedding disabled (oEmbed 401) were identity-checked via i.ytimg.com thumbnail liveness + the channel uploads-playlist enumeration instead; identityMethod field records which path each video used

review.ruling: delegated self-review — owner chat 2026-11-09: 'For now, approve and review yourself'
review.reviewer: delegated self-review (agent, per owner chat 2026-11-09: 'approve and review yourself')
review.evidenceBasis: Title-only posture with the tightened P2D binding rule (title must name the spec's distinctive content). 104/139 medium and 30/35 low rows pass; rejects are A-level-only clauses (recombinant production, biosensors, genetic screening, microarrays, gene editing, mitosis significance) that GCSE-adjacent or generic-titled videos do not name.

rejects.reason: 'Globular Proteins 2 Insulin and Lysozyme' covers insulin structure/function; the recombinant-human-protein production clause of 19.2.1 is not title-evidenced.
'The Regulation of Blood Glucose Concentration' — test strips and biosensors (14.1.11) are A-level-specific clauses, not title-evidenced.
GCSE 'Inherited Disorders' covers the disorders; the genetic-screening framing of 19.2.2 (BRCA, Huntington) is not title-evidenced.
Amoeba 'Gene Expression and Regulation' covers regulation; microarray analysis of genomes (19.1.10) is a distinct technique, not title-evidenced.
Same video: marker genes with fluorescent products (19.1.6) not title-evidenced.
GCSE 'Sexual and Asexual Reproduction' — the significance-of-mitosis clauses (growth, repair, genetic identity) of 5.1.2 are not title-evidenced; keyword-adjacent.
GCSE 'Genetic Engineering' — the gene-editing (CRISPR-style insertion/deletion/replacement) clause of 19.1.7 is not title-evidenced in a GCSE genetic-engineering video.
